reason: A Web UI plugin marketplace that discovers and filters DeepSeek Harness plugins from GitHub, presents trust and compatibility signals, and supports verified, confirmation-gated installation.

summaries.zh: 在 Web UI 中从 GitHub 发现、筛选和排序 DeepSeek Harness 插件，并在校验声明后通过确认安装插件。
summaries.en: Discover, filter, and rank DeepSeek Harness plugins from GitHub in the Web UI, then install them after declaration checks and user confirmation.

capabilities: Crawls public GitHub repositories under the dsh-plugin topic
Filters, searches, ranks, and displays plugin listings
Checks package.json for a dsh.bundle.patch declaration before installation
Displays and, after user confirmation, executes a dsh plugin installation command
